speech.heard: In Niger, 46.2% of females are children. In Japan, it is 10.7%. Central African Republic is the world's highest, where 46.5% of females are children. It counts girls aged 0 to 14 as a percentage of the total female population. South Korea is the opposite at 9.9%, a nation with very few children. Somalia, Mali and Chad are also high, all at 45.5% or more. Nigeria has 40.4%, that is 3.8 times the 10.7% found in Japan. USA has 16.7%, while China is 14.7%. Does your country have a high share of young females?
differences: base.en: 'it counts' heard as 'accounts' after 'females are children'
